mapper.sql: pa.id, pa.provider_id, p.name AS provider_name, p.code AS provider_code, pa.code, pa.name, pa.base_url, pa.status, pa.created_at, pa.updated_at
mapper.select:
select from kb_provider_accounts pa inner join kb_providers p on pa.provider_id = p.id
and ( pa.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or pa.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by pa.id desc
select from kb_provider_accounts pa inner join kb_providers p on pa.provider_id = p.id where pa.id = #{id}

select count(1) from kb_provider_accounts where code = #{code}
and id != #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: insert into kb_provider_accounts(provider_id, code, name, base_url, status) values(#{providerId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{baseUrl}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_provider_accounts set provider_id = #{providerId}, code = #{code}, name = #{name}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
